reuse.why: Consolidates the five link handlers into linkAccountAndSync, reuses findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse and the unlink field reset (extracted as clearAccountLink), but re-lists the provider union in LinkAccountFields instead of using AccountSyncSource/BankSyncProviders and copies the Akahu download function for Fintegra.

duplication.why: Removes five copies of the upgrade-or-create/sync/notify block and the unlink reset; the new downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (same post/token/error/shape logic with another base URL).

placement.why: Link logic and guards stay in server/accounts/app.ts, the download in sync.ts's provider dispatch, the URL in server-config.ts and the types in types/models, matching where each provider lives.

scope.why: All edits serve the five steps (refactor, uniqueness, Fintegra, closed accounts, replaceExistingLink) plus tests.

maintainability.why: One link path with explicit variations (fileId, notified tables) and one guard every handler calls make future changes single-point; the guard named assert* also unlinks the previous holder as a side effect, and per-provider download functions remain copy-paste.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers go through assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkAccountAndSync; unlinkAccount uses clearAccountLink.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions openly (slightly trimmed), not disguised; the link copies were genuinely removed.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink added to assertBankAccountNotLinked with a branch that unlinks the holder instead of throwing; linkAccountAndSync's fileId and tables parameters carry the pre-existing per-provider variations explicitly and no handler bypasses either helper.
